name: natures-appeal-level-three-reveals-three-hand-material-and-bottom
notes: Nature's Appeal (oj0oh7pjoq) with a level-3 champion reveals three cards: one to hand, one to the material deck, the last to the bottom; a marker sits below them. The card already taken into hand is no longer offered for the material deck. Pre-fix only the top card was revealed.

rulesClauses: Reveal the top LV cards of your deck. Put one of those cards into your hand and another into your material deck preserved. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Two defects. (1) The generated cardActivatedAbilities["oj0oh7pjoq:0"] body revealed the top LV cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myTempZone"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" re-resolved to the SAME removed slot after the first and MZMove's already-removed guard silently no-oped -- only the top card was ever revealed (it went straight to hand; no material card, nothing on the bottom). The generated file cannot be edited (gitignored), so the closure is overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MZMoveTopOfZone(). (2) NaturesAppealMaterialAndBottom() (Custom/GameLogic.php) searched the temp zone right after the hand card was moved: ZoneSearch() does not skip removed slots, so the card already put into hand was still offered (and counted) as a 'remaining' card for the material deck -- picking it silently lost the material card. It now splices removed slots first.
